text:
Higgsfield's Supercomputer takes one prompt, produces a month of brand content, and uploads it straight to your socials...on autopilot.

here's how solo founders run a full content org without hiring anyone:

- you give it one task and it picks the workflow itself
- breaks it into sub-tasks and routes each to the model that's best at it
- reasoning models write the hooks, Seedance + Veo render the video, Nano Banana does the stills
- checks every cut for retention so the hook lands fast and the pacing holds
- pulls your brand voice + palette from memory so it matches every run
- then files the assets in the right folder + posts them itself

every step from brief to brand-match to publish runs without you.

reply "CMO" and i'll send you the full breakdown so you can set it up too
content: Use Seedance (alongside Veo) specifically for rendering the video portion of an automated brand-content workflow, while delegating hook writing to a reasoning model and stills to Nano Banana.

translations.es: Utiliza Seedance (junto con Veo) específicamente para renderizar la parte de video de un flujo de trabajo automatizado de contenido de marca, mientras delegas la escritura de ganchos a un modelo de razonamiento y las imágenes fijas a Nano Banana.
translations.fr: Utilisez Seedance (avec Veo) spécifiquement pour le rendu de la partie vidéo d'un flux de travail automatisé de contenu de marque, tout en déléguant l'écriture des accroches à un modèle de raisonnement et les images fixes à Nano Banana.
translations.ja: Seedance（およびVeo）を使用して、自動化されたブランドコンテンツワークフローのビデオ部分をレンダリングし、フックの作成は推論モデルに、静止画はNano Bananaに委任します。
translations.ko: Seedance(및 Veo)를 사용하여 자동화된 브랜드 콘텐츠 워크플로우의 비디오 부분을 렌더링하는 데 집중하고, 후크 작성은 추론 모델에, 스틸 이미지는 Nano Banana에 위임하십시오.
translations.pt-BR: Use o Seedance (junto com o Veo) especificamente para renderizar a parte de vídeo de um fluxo de trabalho automatizado de conteúdo de marca, enquanto delega a escrita de ganchos para um modelo de raciocínio e imagens estáticas para o Nano Banana.
translations.zh-CN: 使用 Seedance（与 Veo 一起）专门用于渲染自动化品牌内容工作流程中的视频部分，同时将引人注目的文案撰写委托给推理模型，将静态图像委托给 Nano Banana。
